newsitem.title: CHINA: China preparing work on $1.87 bln fertiliser plant.
newsitem.headline: China preparing work on $1.87 bln fertiliser plant.

text.p: China is to start work on a 15.58 billion yuan ($1.87 billion) fertiliser plant in the southern province of Hainan early next year, with production to begin in the year 2000, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The project would use offshore natural gas and would have a production capacity of 450,000 tonnes of synthetic ammonia and 800,000 tonnes of urea a year, Xinhua said.
Work on the plant would start next January and would take about 14 months to complete, the agency said.
The plant's first set of processing equipment would be put into trial operation in June 2000, with the second set of equipment coming on line in March 2001, it said but gave no further details.
